comment: Public awareness signals for the constructive-notice gradient: candidate dates from which an organization's awareness clock could be argued to run. Each entry needs date (ISO), tier, label, and citation. Adding an event is a data commit — include the citation and keep labels short. Tier order in the UI: statute-regulation, standards, intergovernmental, survey, industry. The scholarship tier (Mosca 2015 analysis / 2018 theorem publication) is INTENTIONALLY OMITTED pending Darren's ruling on whether foreseeability scholarship belongs on a duty-crystallization ladder (see manuscript Part II.A: epistemic vs. ontic boundary; per standing guardrail, Shor 1994 is never an anchor). 2026 vendor and intergovernmental announcements (G7 follow-up, Google/Microsoft/Oracle/AWS, bank programs) should be added by data commit with citations once dated.
